question.text: If USDINR spot is 83, India's 1-year risk-free rate is 7%, and US 1-year risk-free rate is 5%, what is the approximate 1-year USDINR futures price?

explanation.text: The Logic: Applying interest rate parity: F = S x (1+RINR)/(1+RUSD) = 83 x (1.07/1.05) = 83 x 1.01905 = 84.5809, which rounds to 84.58. The Trap: The formula multiplies spot by the ratio of interest factors; subtracting interest rates from spot will produce an incorrect value. Note: Interest rate parity pricing is covered in the Series I workbook, and a quick estimate is F approximately S + S x (RINR - RUSD) = 83 + 83 x 0.02 = 84.66.
